decisions.reason: As a burner component tightly linked to the firm’s established radiant-heating business, it is cheap to keep available and still offers learning and sales upside with little reason for early abandonment.
The electric infrared panel heater fits the shift toward lower-carbon heating, and after only about a year the firm is likely to preserve this option while demand and positioning become clearer.
The electric halogen infrared heater is somewhat more niche and potentially easier to rationalize later, but uncertainty is still high enough that the firm would likely keep it on the market for now.
This industrial electric infrared hall heater is close to the firm’s core customer base and strategic direction, so management is likely to continue backing it while market acceptance develops.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is strategically important as a real-world option on hydrogen-ready heating, and an early field deployment makes continued market presence valuable despite unresolved uncertainty.
